description: List available slots (eventId, start/end, seats available) for fixed and fixedCourse products in a time window of at most 31 days. Not for flexibleTime products — use bookeo_search_matching_slots for those. Bookeo: GET /availability/slots.

endTime.description: Search window end, max 31 days after start (required unless paging) — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

mode.description: Set to "backend" to act as a manager, relaxing customer-facing limits (time in advance, participant limits, change windows).

pageNavigationToken.description: Token from a previous response's info.pageNavigationToken, to fetch another page. Search parameters need not be repeated.

pageNumber.description: Page to fetch (1-based). Used together with pageNavigationToken.

productId.description: Only this product. Omit for all fixed/fixedCourse products bookable by customers.

startTime.description: Search window start (required unless paging) — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

name: bookeo_get_availability_slots
title: Get availability slots
